name: Impact Documentation Check
description: Checks that impact-model.md is up to date when impact calculation code changes.

then.prompt: The impact calculation code was just edited. Check that docs/impact-model.md still accurately documents: (1) The current values of MEALS_PER_KG and CARBON_PER_KG_FOOD_WASTE constants from backend/src/domain/impact-constants.ts. (2) The formulas: meals = weightKg * MEALS_PER_KG and carbonSaved = weightKg * CARBON_PER_KG_FOOD_WASTE. (3) The metric classification (measured vs calculated vs estimated) for each metric in the impact dashboard. (4) The source/citation for each constant. If docs/impact-model.md is missing or out of date, list the specific sections that need updating.
